Name: Stackable Buff Durations
Author: deleted62143631
Description:
Allows buff durations to stack a customizable number of times past their default length upon reapplying the buff, instead of just resetting the buff length.
Source Code: [url=https://github.com/Imogen599/StackableBuffs]https://github.com/Imogen599/StackableBuffs[/url].

Manifest.Name: StackableBuffs
Manifest.Description: Allows buff durations to stack up to 4 times the default length upon reapplying the buff.
